concerns.text: Task T012 (Define and version all JSON‑schema contracts) is placed after every other task, but many earlier tasks (e.g., T001‑T011) have verification steps that validate against those contracts. The contracts must be produced *before* any task that consumes them to satisfy the foundational‑tasks‑first principle.

Several tasks are marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) despite having explicit data dependencies. For example, T002 reads the parquet file created by T001, and T004 consumes outputs of both T001 and T002. These producer‑consumer relationships forbid parallel execution, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe and violates the parallel‑safety rule.
